answer: Trust-graph conductance resists Sybil attacks by requiring agents to earn signed, weight-capped peer endorsements rather than self-registering. From epoch dawn to audit zenith, verifiers run bounded random walks from trusted seeds, leaving weakly linked clusters stranded on an untrusted ledge. Attackers must earn scarce, independent endorsements to fund trust flow per fake identity. However, compromised hubs or paid vouching rings can bridge the sparse cut.
